text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text:
Take that! Giant snake defeated!
Hehe, after all, I really am the strongest♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おりゃー！　
大蛇撃破！
ふふん、
やっぱりアタシってば最強よね♪

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I'm surprised... I thought you were just a cheeky kid,
but you've done so well. Want a candy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや驚いた……
生意気な子どもとばかり思っていたが、
ここまでやるとはな。
アメちゃん
食べるか？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
Really. You did well, Medusa.
Want some wheat bran snacks?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に。
よく頑張ったわね、
偉いわ
メドゥーサ。
麩菓子
食べる？

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text:
Come on! If you're going to compliment me, just do it normally!
...But I'll take the candy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう！　
ほめるなら普通にほめなさいよ！
……でも、
お菓子はもらっておくわ。

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's capture Kanon and send her back to Gio Gehenna—
Ah! She's gone! The giant snake has disappeared too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
ではカノンを捕らえて
ジオ・ゲヘナに強制送還する──
あっ！　
いない！　
大蛇も姿を消してるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Medusa
text_block_list.text:
Did she run away!?
Even as a self-proclaimed princess, she should have some dignity!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイツ、
逃げちゃったの！？
仮にも王女を名乗るなら
堂々としてなさいってのよ！

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text:
If she's running away, she surely hasn't learned her lesson, right?
We have to find her before she causes another commotion!
text_block_list.orig_text:
逃げるくらいだから、
絶対に懲りてないわよね。
また騒ぎを起こす前に
見つけださなきゃ！
